chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
I said, 'We see a man who has worship, striving, and humility, but he does not speak with the Truth (Wilayah); will that benefit him in any way?'

He said, 'O Abu Muhammad! The example of the People of the Household is like the example of a household among the Children of Israel. No one from them would strive for forty nights and supplicate except that he would be answered.'

And indeed, a man from them strived for forty nights, then supplicated, but he was not answered. So he came to Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him), complaining to him of what he was in, and asked him for supplication.

So Isa purified himself and prayed, then supplicated to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him: 'O Isa! My servant came to me from other than the door through which I am approached.'
'He supplicated to me, and in his heart was doubt about you. So even if he were to supplicate to me until his neck breaks and his fingers scatter, I will not answer him.'
He said, 'So Isa (peace be upon him) turned towards him and said, 'You supplicate to your Lord while you are in doubt about His Prophet?''
So he said, 'O Spirit of Allah and His Word! It has been, by Allah, what you said. So supplicate to Allah for me that He removes it from me.'
So Isa (peace be upon him) supplicated for him, and Allah turned to him (with forgiveness) and accepted from him, and he came to be within the limit of the People of the Household.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the Household (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.الْبَابُ: The door/channel of approach to God, referring to Wilayah

ai.seo_question: Why did a man's prolonged worship and supplication fail to be answered in the story of the Children of Israel?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* underscores the Shia doctrine that sincere belief in the *Wilayah* of the Imams is a prerequisite for the acceptance of worship, illustrating that ritual devotion without theological certainty is insufficient. The narrative draws a parallel between the Children of Israel and the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that doubt (*shakk*) in the divinely appointed guide nullifies the efficacy of supplication, a principle central to Usuli scholarship. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the interconnection between creed (*aqidah*) and practice (*fiqh*) in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), said, ‘I said, ‘We see the man who has worshipped, and the striving, and the humbleness, but he is not saying with the truth (Al-Wilayah). So would then he get any benefit?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! An example of the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household is like an example of the People of the Household who used to be among the Children of Israel (Prophet Isa<sup>as</sup>). It was so that no one from them (the nation of Isa<sup>as</sup>) would strive for more than forty nights and supplicate except it would be Answered.

And that a man from them (Children of Israel) strived for forty nights, then supplicated, but it was not Answered for him. So he came over to Isaas Bin Maryamas complaining to himas of what he was in and asked himas of the supplication. So Isaas purified and prayed Salāt, then supplicated to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic. So Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto himas: “O Isaas! Myazwj servant came to me from other than the door which Iazwj am approached. He supplicated to Meazwj and in his heart was doubt about youas. So even if he were to supplicate to meazwj to the extent that his neck breaks off and his fingers scatter (disintegrate), Iazwj will not Answer for him”.

He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> turned towards him and said, ‘You supplicated to your Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and you were in doubt about His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Prophet<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>?’

So he said, ‘O Spirit of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Word! It has been so, by Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, what you<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> said. Therefore, supplicate for me that He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Removes it from me’.

So Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> supplicated for him, and Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Turned towards him (with Forgiveness), and Accepted from him, and he came to be within a limit (closer) of his<sup class="bTxt">as</sup> family’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ali ibn Asbat from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:
“Once I said to one of (two Imam) (a.s.) ‘We find a man who worships, and strives with humility but does not believe in the truth (Shi’a belief). Will it be of any benefit for him?’

The Imam said, ‘O abu Muhammad, the case of AM al-Bayt (of Muhammad) is like that AM al-Bayt in the family of Israel. An individual of that family would strive for forty nights and pray, his prayers received the answer.
Only one man of that family strived for forty nights and prayed but his prayer did not receive any answer. When Jesus, son of Mary came, he complained to him about his case and asked him for prayer.

The Imam said that Jesus then cleansed himself, said the prayer, prayed to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, and Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, sent revelations to Jesus that said, ‘O Jesus, My servant came to Me from a door that is other than the door from which one must come to Me.
He prayed and there was doubt in his heart about you. Were he to pray to Me until his neck would be cut off (disintegrate) and his fingers turn into dust, I would not answer his prayer.’
The Imam said, ‘Jesus then turned to the man and asked, ‘Do you ask your Lord for help while you have doubt in His prophet?’
The man said, ‘O Spirit of Allah and His word, it has been just as you said. Pray to Allah for me to remove doubt from me. ’
The Imam said that Jesus than prayed for him and Allah accepted his repentance and he became like all the other ones of that family.’”
